Unique code, e.g. administrator or staff
Unique scoped code such as `catalog:write`
Composite PK; FKs to roles/permissions
Composite PK; grant actor references users
Unique token digest; consuming transaction verifies email and invitation state
Unique secret digest; FK user; server expiry applies to browser and native
Purpose separates reset/email verification; digest unique when populated; attempts nonnegative; consume under lock
Unique active credential reference; secrets encrypted with external key management
Unique digest; single use
PK/FK user; internal notes omitted from customer DTO
FK user; at most one default per customer via partial unique index
Unique slug; parent FK; service prevents cycles
Unique slug; category FK; status draft/published/archived; gender men/women/unisex
PK old_slug; FK product; slug namespace cannot collide with current slugs
Unique SKU; unique `(product_id, size_code, color_code)`; normalize absent option to `default`; prices nonnegative; compare-at must be at least price when set
Unique object key; bounded dimensions/bytes; status quarantined/approved/rejected
Product/asset FKs; optional variant must belong to same product, enforced using composite FK or transactional validation
Unique slug
Composite PK; FKs

Composite PK; FKs; deterministic ordering
PK/FK variant; all quantities nonnegative; `reserved + allocated <= on_hand`

Unique `(cart_id, variant_id)`; quantity between 1 and 99; no trusted client unit price

Unique revision; immutable once published; schema-validated configuration

FKs; quantity > 0; returned quantity between 0 and quantity; unique `(order_id, variant_id)` at launch; line totals follow saved allocations
Unique digest; FK order; secret never returned in unauthenticated order-number lookup
Append-only; source event unique when present; no backward edits

Unique `(shipment_id, provider_event_id)`; deduplicate normalized synthetic key if provider lacks ID
